question: How long does standard shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within India. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days for an additional fee of Rs 150.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Currently we only ship within India. International shipping is not yet available, but we're working on adding it in 2027.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships
column5: you'll receive an email with a tracking link. You can also track it under My Orders on our website or app.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Items can be returned within 15 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging with tags attached. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

question: Can I return a sale item?
answer: Sale and clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned unless defective.

question: How do I start a return?
answer: Go to My Orders
column6: and click Request Return. You'll get a prepaid return label via email within 24 hours.

question: What is the warranty period on electronics?
answer: Most electronics carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects. Accessories like cables and cases carry a 90-day warranty.

question: How do I claim warranty?
answer: Contact support with your order ID and a description of the issue. We'll arrange a pickup, repair, or replacement depending on the case.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for orders under Rs 10,000.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available everywhere?
answer: COD is available in most pin codes except a few remote areas. You'll see COD as an option at checkout only if it's available for your address.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments can be declined due to insufficient balance
column6: or incorrect card details. Please retry or use a different payment method.

question: How do I cancel an order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled for free within 1 hour of placing them, from My Orders > Cancel Order. After that, cancellation depends on whether the order has shipped.

question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
answer: Address changes are possible only before the order ships. Contact support immediately with your order ID to request a change.

question: My order shows delivered but I haven't received it
answer: Please wait a few hours as some couriers mark orders delivered slightly early. If it doesn't arrive within 24 hours, contact support with your order ID and we'll investigate with the courier.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the link sent to your registered email. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Email privacy@techmart.example with a deletion request. Your account and personal data will be removed within 30 days per our privacy policy.

question: Do your headphones support Bluetooth 5.0?
answer: Yes

question: What is the battery life of the SmartWatch X2?
answer: The SmartWatch X2 offers up to 7 days of battery life on a single charge with typical use
column5: or 2 days with always-on display enabled.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday
column5: 9 AM to 6 PM IST. Messages sent outside these hours are answered the next business day.

question: Can I talk to a human agent?
answer: Yes, just type 'talk to agent' or 'human' at any point in the chat, and you'll be connected to our support team.
